messages.subject: Meridian/Harcourt – liability landing zone
messages.plaintextBody:
Both,

Proposed landing zone before I speak to Henry:
- General cap: 150% of trailing 12-month fees.
- Data-protection super-cap: 300% of the annual subscription fee = £2,520,000. This is our ceiling.
- Payment: split the difference at 45 days.
- Renewal notice: hold at 90 days.

That gives Harcourt a real number on data breach (£2.52m) without exposing Meridian to uncapped risk. Elena, please prepare a v3 response redline reflecting these once Henry signs off.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
